purpose: 官方测试政策第 6 层的插件级对应物：父代提供输入与模型回放，子代是期望的持久结果。
父代（输入）：本地 OpenAI 兼容 stub 的固定回放，加上一次真机 DSH 无头会话里插件注入进模型上下文的 <rules> 块。
子代（持久结果）：一次性 DSH_HOME 里那次会话留下的会话持久化文件，本文件记录从它重新读回的 rules-context 正文。
两侧正文都记在 session 里：modelVisibleRulesText 是模型实际收到的，injectedRulesText 是会话落盘的；两者必须逐字一致。
插件状态文件 state.json 由管理面板写入，无头会话不改写状态，故如实记为 null —— 这条 null 本身就是「无头会话不写状态」的断言。
录制里不含任何本机路径：临时项目目录、一次性 DSH_HOME 与临时根目录的前缀已替换为占位。

session.modelVisibleRulesText:
<rules>
The rules section has a number of possible rules/context that you should consider. In each subsection, we provide instructions about what information the subsection contains and how you should consider/follow the contents of the subsection. Explicit user rules take precedence over default tool preferences described in tool descriptions.
<always_applied_workspace_rules description="These are rules set by the project that you should follow if appropriate.">

RESIDENT_MARKER_ALPHA: 这条规则 alwaysApply 为真，正文必须整段进入注入块。
它用来证明常驻规则的正文确实到达了模型可见的请求里。


</always_applied_workspace_rules>
<agent_requestable_workspace_rules description="These are workspace-level rules that the agent should follow. They can request the full details of the rule with the read_rules tool.">

Use read rule tool to fetch the rule content if needed. In <agent_requestable_workspace_rules> section, key is the rule's absolute file path, value is rule's description.
- <PROJECT>\.codebuddy\rules\ondemand.mdc: ONDEMAND_DESCRIPTION_MARKER 按需夹具规则，只有描述常驻

</agent_requestable_workspace_rules>
</rules>
